status: Fixed before evaluating the three-region model scores
objective: Measure soil-moisture reconstruction accuracy under progressively stronger spatial and regional separation and quantify the value of labelled target-region sites
target: swvl1 at the recorded time and location

main_protocols.name: random_rows
main_protocols.purpose: Diagnostic of conventional randomly mixed records

main_protocols.name: random_sites
main_protocols.purpose: Both dates of a site remain together; nearby sites may occur in training

main_protocols.name: buffered_quadrants
main_protocols.purpose: Within-region prediction across separated spatial blocks

main_protocols.name: leave_region_out
main_protocols.purpose: Train on the two source folders after excluding the target rectangle and its coordinate buffer; test the complete target region; no target labels in training

weights: Cosine-latitude weights normalized to equal total weight per retained training-region provenance and mean weight one overall after alphabetical deduplication; target-region evaluation uses cosine-latitude weights. Macro RMSE is the arithmetic mean of the three region-specific RMSEs, and regional R2 is computed from all out-of-fold predictions.

adaptation.selection: Seeded nested subsets of eligible target training sites, retaining all dates at each selected site
adaptation.source_plus_target_weights: Target-labelled subset receives one-half of total weight and each of two source regions receives one-quarter, with cosine-latitude weighting within each subset
adaptation.interpretation: Pooled supervised learning with target labels; not unsupervised domain adaptation

diagnostics: source-feature min-max envelope exceedance on held-out target region
controls: no claims of field validation, temporal forecasting, salinity prediction or a novel learning algorithm
